description: writeDocx: markdown in, the structure of the generated .docx out (parts, body defaults, heading styles, paragraphs with runs). Compared by structure, not bytes.

cases.name: headings map to Heading1 to Heading6

args:
# H1
## H2
### H3
#### H4
##### H5
###### H6
####### seven hashes is text

paragraphs.text: Some bold and italic and both text.

cases.name: nested emphasis takes the first match
bullets and numbers use list numbering
a decimal number is not an ordered item
emoji get their own font run
flags and skin tones stay one emoji
CRLF line endings split like LF
empty body is one empty paragraph
surrounding spaces are trimmed per line
a heading marker with no text is body text
non-ASCII digits are not ordered items
a line separator stops a heading match
a no-break space counts as heading whitespace
